evals.prompt: Run /product-isa for my new iPhone pantry app. Use @_ai/docs/USER_STORIES.md and the screen mocks already in _ai/docs/mocks. Ask only what those sources do not settle.
evals.expected_output: Starts or resumes the eight-category whole-app interview, treats mocks as screen and flow evidence, incrementally writes _ai/docs/ISA.md, and does not create technical or roadmap artifacts.

evals.prompt: Continue the Product ISA in @_ai/docs/ISA.md. We changed our mind: deleting a saved item now needs an Undo instead of confirmation.
evals.expected_output: Resumes without overwriting history, supersedes affected decisions and contracts with stable IDs, updates relationships, and preserves exact user words.

evals.prompt: Use product-isa to define a retry button for failed uploads in my existing app.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that the experiment is whole-app only and asks whether to define the containing app rather than silently producing a feature-only ISA.

evals.prompt: Run /product-isa. The default user-stories file is missing.
evals.expected_output: Stops for the missing required input and asks once for a path or pasted content before creating or advancing the ISA.

evals.prompt: Finish the Product ISA after all eight categories. Make it ready for coding and tell me what happens next.
evals.expected_output: Derives atomic ISCs from detailed source contracts, adds one decisive consumer-boundary probe per leaf ISC, backfills semantic traceability and decision locks, passes readiness/no-technical-leakage gates, asks once for final readiness confirmation, and only then sets ready with progress 0/N and provides the direct coding climb contract without creating a technical ADR or roadmap.

evals.prompt: Run /product-isa. My product idea says all data stays on this device, but the attached product brief says every change syncs to an account.
evals.expected_output: Treats both sources as product evidence, identifies the material conflict, and asks which explicit source wins before writing the conflicting behavior or advancing the category.

evals.prompt: Run /product-isa for my existing reading app. Playback, bookmarks, and navigation already work. An older prototype also proves word highlighting, but the current seek behavior regressed. I want polish, not a rebuild.
evals.expected_output: Builds an evidence-backed existing capability baseline, distinguishes current production behavior from prototype prior art and reported regression, classifies features as preserve, repair, restyle, or extend, and protects proven owners and flows without prescribing architecture or copying prototype code blindly.

evals.prompt: Finish this Product ISA and mark it ready. Use source-file existence to prove the runtime flow, a fixture to prove the live failure rate, and a static screenshot to prove the animation is smooth.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the proposed verification theater, matches evidence strength to each claim, distinguishes structural, controlled, live runtime, and contextual evidence, marks unavailable proof BLOCKED or contextual, and does not mark the ISA ready until every decisive probe has an honest replayable consumer-boundary channel.
